summary: No code change. Round 2's code at ee461d32 is what the tester verified; its one failure was that the round carried no CI, because the push that carried the three code commits ended on the implement handoff commit, whose message carries skip-checks: true, and GitHub reads that trailer on the head of the push. This round pushes heads that carry no such trailer so the lanes run for that code.

filesChanged: No code, documentation or test file changed this round. The branch gains 9c2ea00f, an empty commit whose message carries no skip-checks trailer, and this handoff commit, also written without the trailer, so GitHub starts the lanes for the code of ee461d32.
trickyParts: GitHub reads the skip-checks trailer on the head of the push, not on each commit: a push that carries code commits without the trailer and ends on a handoff commit with it starts no workflow for any of them. From now on every push of this issue that carries code ends on a commit without the trailer, and the handoff goes in a push of its own.
discoveredComplexity: The empty commit 9c2ea00f, pushed at 19:29Z with no trailer, had started no workflow when this handoff was written, while the repository's Actions were live for other branches at 19:25-19:27Z. This handoff commit is a file change pushed the same way, which is the second shape the architect named; the checks at the head are read and reported with the completion.

Sibling contracts: the round-2 /healthz change reached INFRA-594's implementer from me and INFRA-514's and INFRA-590's from the tester. From this round on the implementer tells each sibling implementer itself whenever a shared contract changes.
